list_cap.because: every list of the tool's answer that grows with the model stops at ten names and counts the rest (metrics_render.ANSWER_LIST_CAP)

none_more.because: nothing past the first ten: the precondition is that some name is past them

expectations.because: the components that are not external stubs, counted off the files by the locator
the directed dependencies, each pair once: the specimen's connectors outnumber its pairs, so a count of connectors fails
the precondition: the specimen's unconnected ports are more than one list holds, so the cap is a check the answer can fail
a list that grows with the model is capped, so the answer's size does not follow the model
the names listed and the count of the rest add up to every unconnected port the specimen holds: a capped list drops nothing silently
the tool carries no per-component row; those are the CLI's
the tool carries no table per composition, whose size is not bounded by a constant; the count stays in size
